# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repo (instead of loaded from a CDN) so the app works fully offline.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pmtiles.js` | [pmtiles](https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles) | 4.5.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `protomaps-leaflet.js` | [protomaps-leaflet](https://github.com/protomaps/protomaps-leaflet) | 5.1.0 | BSD-3-Clause |

Both are the unmodified UMD builds from npm (`dist/`).
